Short guides to using language models in research: where to start, how to check what a model gives you, and the rules of journals and observatories. Each guide has authors, a catalogue number to cite it, and the date it was last checked.

Have an idea for a guide, or a guide you wrote? [Propose it](../contribute.qmd).
